name: JJtorio
title: JJtorio
author: JJ
description: JJtorio is an early work in progress overhaul for Factorio 2.0. Today (0.1.x) it is a lighter, faster early game, more reach, cheaper and faster research, and a bigger starting inventory, with the rocket silo gated behind a mature base. Planned for 0.2 and beyond is an endless, procedurally generated universe. Reach orbit, unlock an original orbital science tier, and settle planets that each force a different way to build, on top of an early game restructured so vanilla blueprints do not just paste in. Standalone and deliberately incompatible with major overhauls like Space Age, Space Exploration, Krastorio 2, Bob's, and Angel's. Source and issues on GitHub: https://github.com/JJtmc1234/JJtorio. Community feedback welcome, email jjtmcmultiversal@gmail.com with the subject 'JJtorio'.
